🪔 DIWALI WALI QAWALI🪔

A Bollywood Sufi Night: 20 Stories High in Manhattan🎶 LIVE WITH HIS BAND | SUFI-BOLLYWOOD FUSION
Get ready for an unforgettable night of soulful melodies and Bollywood magic as and his live band take over the iconic 230 Fifth Rooftop in Manhattan!
Experience the mesmerizing fusion of traditional Sufi music and Bollywood’s most beloved melodies, brought to life through powerful vocals, captivating rhythms, and an atmosphere that will touch your soul.
From heart-wrenching Sufi classics to the songs that make you sing along with every word, this is more than a concert, it’s a celebration of music, culture, and connection, high above the Manhattan skyline.

🌟 THE NIGHT UNFOLDS🎤 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM | Sherry Khan LIVE Immerse yourself in a soul-stirring live performance featuring the magic of Sufi and Bollywood fusion.
🎶 Sing along to timeless favorites like Teri Deewani and Rashq-e-Qamar.
🕯️ An Enchanting Experience Candlelit ambiance, breathtaking city views, and an unforgettable setting 20 stories above Manhattan.
🔥 10:00 PM – 3:30 AM | Bollywood Afterparty with DJ Browny When the live music ends, the party begins! Dance the night away to your favorite Bollywood hits, desi beats, and party anthems.
Your Qawali ticket includes FREE ACCESS to the Bollywood afterparty!
🍸 Top-shelf bar and food available for purchase.
